title: Base change of an etale ring map is etale
statement: Let $R\to A$ and $R\to S$ be homomorphisms of commutative rings such that $\operatorname{Spec}A\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Then $\operatorname{Spec}(S\otimes_RA)\to\operatorname{Spec}S$, induced by $s\mapsto s\otimes1$, is etale.

source.place: Lemma Tag 00U2 (lemma-etale), item (2) (base change of an etale ring map is etale), used in the proof of Lemma Tag 08HQ (lemma-map-into-henselian)
